description.zh: 锋利无比，更容易刺穿铠甲，但似乎不是十分耐用。

description.zh: 在山纹甲基础上增添了披风和吞肩兽，多为统军者、统领者所穿戴。
description.en: Mountain-pattern armor enhanced with a cloak and beast-head pauldrons, typically worn by army commanders and leaders.

description.zh: 在普通毛胄的基础上增加了白缨作为装饰，多为北方将领佩戴。
description.en: A fur helmet enhanced with a white plume, typically worn by northern generals.

name.en: The Lu clan of Wu Commandery

desc.zh: 出自妫姓，齐宣王少子通封于平原陆乡，后裔以乡为氏，吴郡顶级望族。江东首望，和顾、朱、张一起被称为“吴中四姓”。陆逊为东吴丞相、大都督，夷陵之战大破刘备；陆抗、陆机、陆云皆一时人杰。白马之祸后家族受挫，唐亡后逐渐迁徙分化。
desc.en: Descended from the Gui surname, when King Xuan of Qi's youngest son Tong was enfeoffed at Lu Township in Pingyuan, his descendants adopted the township as their surname, becoming a premier aristocratic clan of Wu Commandery. Renowned as the foremost clan of Jiangdong, they were hailed alongside the Gu, Zhu, and Zhang as the 'Four Great Clans of Wu'. Lu Xun served Eastern Wu as Chancellor and Grand Viceroy, decisively defeating Liu Bei at the Battle of Yiling, Lu Kang, Lu Ji, and Lu Yun were all outstanding figures of their eras. Following the Baima Station Massacre, the Family suffered setbacks, gradually migrating and branching off after the fall of the Tang dynasty.

name.en: Three Heroes of the Late Han

biography.zh: 陆逊之孙，陆抗次子，陆机、陆云之兄，东吴后期名将。陆景幼拜骑都尉，封毗陵侯。陆抗卒，与兄陆晏、弟陆机、陆云等分领父部曲。为人清操有志节，好学深思，虽身在军旅，手不释卷。尝著书数十篇。天纪四年，晋军伐吴。王濬顺江而下，陆晏先战死。陆景率军抵御晋师，奋战，为晋军所害，年三十一。吴人惜之。
biography.tc: 陸遜之孫，陸抗次子，陸機、陸云之兄，東吳后期名將。陸景幼拜騎都尉，封毗陵侯。陸抗卒，與兄陸晏、弟陸機、陸云等分領父部曲。為人清操有志節，好學深思，雖身在軍旅，手不釋卷。嘗著書數十篇。天紀四年，晉軍伐吳。王濬順江而下，陸晏先戰死。陸景率軍抵御晉師，奮戰，為晉軍所害，年三十一。吳人惜之。
biography.en: A native of Wu County in Wu Commandery (present-day Suzhou, Jiangsu). Born into the most illustrious military family of Eastern Wu, he was the grandson of Prime Minister Lu Xun and the son of Grand Minister Lu Kang. When Lu Kang died, Lu Ji, then only fourteen, divided command of his father's troops with his brothers and served as Standard-Bearer General. In the first year of Taikang, the twenty-year-old Lu Ji witnessed the fall of Wu in person. Over the following ten years he retired to his hometown, studied diligently behind closed doors, and wrote ‘Bianwanglun’, his celebrated political essay summing up the rise and fall of Wu. In the tenth year of Taikang, Lu Ji went to Luoyang together with his younger brother Lu Yun and won the esteem of the celebrated scholar Zhang Hua. People of the time said, ‘When the Two Lus enter Luoyang, the Three Zhangs drop in price’, and together with Gu Rong and Lu Yun he was hailed as one of the Three Paragons of Luoyang. Lu Ji also joined the Twenty-Four Friends, the literary circle of the powerful minister Jia Mi. During the War of the Eight Princes, he successively attached himself to Sima Lun and Sima Ying. When Sima Lun, Prince of Zhao, usurped the throne, Lu Ji accepted a post under the illegitimate regime and was nearly executed, escaping only through the intervention of Sima Ying, Prince of Chengdu. Later entrusted by Sima Ying, he was appointed Governor of Pingyuan, Rear Commander, and Viceroy of Hebei, and led an army to campaign against Sima Yi, Prince of Changsha. In the second year of Tai'an, Lu Ji was utterly defeated at the Battle of Luyuan (the Battle of Qilijian). After the battle he was falsely accused of plotting rebellion, and Sima Ying ordered that his clan be exterminated to three degrees. On the eve of his execution Lu Ji lamented: ‘I would fain hear once more the cranes crying at Huating—can that ever be had again!’
biography.jp: 陸遜の孫、陸抗の次男であり、陸機・陸雲の兄にあたる。東呉後期の名将である。陸景は幼くして騎都尉（きとい）に任ぜられ、毗陵侯（ひりょうこう）に封じられた。陸抗が没すると、兄の陸晏、弟の陸機・陸雲らとともに、父の部曲（ぶきょく）を分け統べた。人となりは清操にして志節篤く、学を好み深く思惟した。軍旅の身にありながら、常に書巻を手から離さなかった。かつて数十篇の書を著したという。天紀四年（280年）、晋軍が呉を討った。王濬（おう しゅん）が長江を下ると、陸晏がまず戦死した。陸景は軍を率いて晋軍を阻み、奮戦したが晋軍に討たれた。年三十一。呉の人々はその死を惜しんだ。
biography.kr: 육손의 손자이며 육항의 둘째 아들이자 육기·육운의 형으로, 동오 후기의 명장이다. 육경은 젊어서 기도위에 임명되고 비릉후에 봉해졌다. 육항이 세상을 떠나자, 형 육안과 아우 육기·육운 등과 함께 아버지의 부곡을 나누어 거느렸다. 사람됨이 맑고 지조가 굳었으며, 배우기를 좋아하고 사색이 깊어 군중에 몸담고서도 손에서 책을 놓지 않았다. 일찍이 수십 편의 저술을 남겼다. 천기 4년(280년), 진나라 군대가 오를 정벌하였다. 왕준이 장강을 따라 내려오자 육안이 먼저 전사하였다. 육경은 군사를 이끌고 진군을 막아 격렬히 싸웠으나 진군에게 피살되니, 나이 서른하나였다. 오나라 사람들은 그의 죽음을 애석히 여겼다.
